scientific_integrity: Proof uses explicitly credited prior exceptional-set criterion; independent mathematical audit has not been performed. Finite checker runs corroborate but do not establish asymptotic claims.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns ordinary binary partitions and three-square exceptional indices, not colored partitions or general quadratic forms. It does not resolve automaticity of the ordered gap sequence; a possible equivalent result outside inspected sources remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Exact frequencies of all six gaps in the binary-partition three-square exceptional set
